title: Mika's four days
disclaimer: Fictional simulation. Mika, every company, statement and statistic here is invented.

shots.narration: This is Mika. She lives in Ishinomaki. At six forty-one, her biggest problem was the toaster.

notification.author: Ministry of Reassurance
notification.text: We can confirm the ground has been asked to remain still. The situation remains fluid.

shots.narration: At six forty-two, a magnitude 7.8 earthquake struck off the coast of Miyagi. Her phone already had a statement ready.

notification.author: Shrug Mutual Insurance
notification.text: Water damage is covered unless the water came from the sea, a river, the sky or a pipe. See clause 94(b).

shots.narration: Three minutes later came a tsunami warning, and a helpful note about her insurance.

notification.author: ThriftJet Air
notification.text: ThriftJet now offers Evacuation Class: same seat, louder announcements. Bags extra.

shots.narration: Mika joined the walk to higher ground. Her phone offered her an upgrade.

notification.author: Synergexa
notification.text: Introducing CandleBox™ Premium: the outage-ready subscription. Now three times the price.

shots.narration: At the shelter, the power went out. Her phone, on four percent, suggested a candle subscription.

notification.author: Committee for Global Stability (Interim)
notification.text: We warmly welcome the aid from the United States and have formed a working group to decide where to put it.

shots.narration: On day two, rescue teams arrived from the United States, along with a form. Mika started page one of six hundred.

notification.author: Committee for Global Stability (Interim)
notification.text: We have established a subcommittee to determine whether this constitutes a precedent.

shots.narration: That evening, another aftershock. A subcommittee met to decide whether it set a precedent. Mika reached page two hundred.

notification.author: Brandwell Inc.
notification.text: We apologise for any inconvenience the crisis caused. The crisis was not us. Use code BACK20.

shots.narration: On day four, the trains came back, and so did Mika. The toast was exactly where she left it.
